[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean BBQ typically involves grilling marinated meat, often beef or pork, on a tabletop grill.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Japanese Yakitori is a type of grilled chicken skewer often served as a snack or appetizer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The chicken in Yakitori is usually seasoned with salt or a sweet/savory sauce and grilled over charcoal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean BBQ tends to be more of a sit-down meal with a variety of dishes served.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yakitori is typically eaten on the go or as a small plate.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some people enjoy Yakitori with a simple seasoning of salt or soy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Others prefer a more complex sauce made with soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, and spices like ginger and garlic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Among the more popular Yakitori sauces is tare, a thick and sweet sauce that adds a rich flavor to the grilled chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ponzu, a citrusy soy sauce, is another popular sauce for Yakitori.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The choice of sauce for Yakitori comes down to personal preferences, and there are many different options to try!
